summary: Fail-closed local snapshot and restore adapter

delivery.outcome: Publish fail-closed stopped-container context snapshot and fresh-directory restore with synthetic recovery evidence.

architecture.decision: Bounded Docker tar capture from an exact stopped container; strict single SQLite file inventory, readonly integrity verification and exclusive publication. Restore prepares a fresh private directory only and never activates services.
architecture.rollback: No existing source data or runtime is changed. Preserve failed diagnostic evidence; discard only exact operator-owned outputs separately.

validation.evidence: Bounded copy, identity, tar and integrity negative tests
Synthetic snapshot/restore round-trip and no-overwrite tests
Managed gate and protected publication receipt
